verdict.rationale: Alloy documents workflows that "apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met", and it references manual review events and "fully auditable agentic automation". Together these suggest policy-driven automation with escalation to human investigation, but the evidence is thin and never describes limiting the automation itself. missing for 10: explicit controls for capping or gating automatic agentic remediation by policy, documented routing of ambiguous or high-risk cases to human review queues, approval workflows before automated actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can limit automatic remediation by policy and escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human

citations.quote: apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met
asynchronous events like when a watchlist gets updated or a manual review occurs
